## Frequently asked questions

What is Disprz?


Disprz is an AI-powered learning and skilling platform that combines LMS, LXP, and AI content authoring to help enterprises build workforce capability at scale. It connects learning, skill development, and business outcomes in a single platform.

What use cases is Disprz built for?


Disprz helps mid-market and enterprise organizations scale learning, skilling, and enablement across employees, frontline teams, partners, and customers. It is used across industries such as retail, BFSI, manufacturing, IT/ITeS, and services, and supports organizations of all sizes, from growing teams to large enterprises. Companies like Amazon, Axis Bank, Starbucks, and Bharat Petroleum trust Disprz to power workforce capability at scale.

How does Disprz use AI in enterprise learning?


Disprz uses AI to help organizations create learning content faster, map skills to roles, personalize learning journeys, and provide insights into workforce capability development.

Is Disprz an LMS or an LXP?


Disprz offers both LMS and LXP capabilities. It provides the structured learning management and training administration features of an LMS, along with the skills-driven, personalized learning experiences of an LXP. Organizations can choose to deploy the LMS, the LXP, or both together depending on their learning and skilling requirements.

Is Disprz compliant with data privacy and security regulations?


Yes. Disprz follows enterprise-grade security practices and complies with leading standards such as SOC 2, ISO certifications, and GDPR.

Can Disprz integrate with our HR or enterprise systems?


Yes. Disprz integrates with common HRIS, HCM, collaboration tools, and enterprise applications through APIs and pre-built integrations so learning can be embedded into existing workflows.

How quickly can organizations implement Disprz?


Implementation timelines depend on factors such as the number of users, integrations, and level of customization required. Most organizations can get started quickly, while larger enterprise deployments may take longer depending on the scope and complexity of the implementation.

What makes Disprz different from a traditional LMS?


Traditional LMS platforms focus on course management. Disprz goes further by combining learning delivery, skill intelligence, and AI-powered content creation to enable continuous workforce capability development.
